Name: Daphne's Ice Cream Truck
Author: wabiii
Description:
[size=3][b]For Version 3.0.X [/b][/size][list]
[*][size=3]Pink, blue, and green ice cream truck config options [/size]
[*][size=3]Shop opens 9am-6pm [/size]
[/list][size=3]
How To Spawn Truck Using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27359]Buildings Included[/url] Mod 
[spoiler]1. (optional) Read Daphne's letter. 
2. Ensure there is space for the truck to spawn at the designated farm coordinates (Default Coordinates: 49 10), or configure XY coordinates in the Config. You can also turn on Debug Mode in the Config to allow the truck to spawn if obstructed by map tiles, and turn it off when it's been moved. 
3. Enter Town on a sunny day between 8am and 11pm to trigger Daphne's cutscene. 
4. (optional) Change Config to be buildable at the Carpenter's Shop. 
[/size][size=3]
[/size][size=3][/spoiler] [/size][size=3]Known Issues [list]
[*][size=3]Closed Message is not working [/size]
[*][size=3]Unable to close shop in winter [/size]
[*][size=3]Portraiture v1.12.1-alpha.20240304 is incompatible with buildings shop portrait. [/size]
[/list]
[b]For Version 2.1.0 [/b][/size][list][spoiler][*][size=3]This is a pack for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12311]Solid Foundations[/url]﻿ mod, which can be downloaded in the requirements alongside [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5005]STF[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]JA[/url]﻿ to enable the van to have a shop. [/size]
[*][size=3]Can be built directly anywhere on your farm! [/size]
[*][size=3]Daphne will send a letter and have a small event to introduce herself after you open her shop for the first time [/size]
[*][size=3]Pink blue and green option with winter seasonals {although her shop is closed in winter!!} [/size]
[*][size=3]You buy the building from Robins like you normally would with any vanilla building[/size][size=3] [/size][/spoiler]
[/list][center][size=3]
